financial_valid_approval.label: Loan approval (valid)
financial_valid_approval.scenario: A regional bank approves a ¥5,000,000 small-business loan. The applicant's exact income is never disclosed to the bank's AI; Lemma proves only that income exceeds the policy threshold and that the applicant is not on any AML watchlist.
businessImpact: Audit response in under a second vs ~3 days of manual review
Borrower's income never disclosed to bank or regulator
Regulator can verify the proof directly, no trust required

financial_tampered_output.label: Loan approval (tampered output)
financial_tampered_output.scenario: The same loan approval, but the approval document was edited after the AI signed it. Lemma detects the tampering before the document is presented to compliance.
financial_tampered_output.failReason: The approval output was modified after the AI signed it. The output commitment no longer matches the value bound at issuance, so verification stops here.

without: Tampered approval passes silently into the loan portfolio
Compliance discovers the mismatch weeks later, during audit
Bank faces regulatory penalty for a non-compliant decision
with: Tampering detected in under a second, before document is presented
Cryptographic audit trail of the original AI-signed output is preserved
Regulator verifies the original commitment directly, no trust required

manufacturing_valid_process.label: Process compliance (valid)
manufacturing_valid_process.scenario: A parts manufacturer ships a batch to an EU buyer. Lemma proves the production process conformed to the registered ESG/CBAM-compliant specification.
businessImpact: CBAM proof generated at ship time vs ~2 weeks of compliance documentation
Process spec changes are tracked cryptographically, not by emails
Buyer verifies compliance independently, no auditor required

manufacturing_model_swap.label: Process compliance (model swap)
manufacturing_model_swap.scenario: The same shipment, but a different AI inspection model was substituted between certification and shipment. Lemma detects the substitution via envelope signature mismatch.
manufacturing_model_swap.failReason: The envelope was signed under a different model than the one declared. Verification stops at the envelope step.

without: Shipment proceeds with the unverified inspection model
Defect surfaces only after the EU import, triggering recall
Recall cost plus import-ban risk fall on the manufacturer
with: Substitution detected before the shipment leaves the plant
Re-issue requires the originally certified model, not a swap
Recall avoided; CBAM filing references the verified envelope

agent_valid_chain_with_x402.label: Agent chain + x402 payment (valid)
agent_valid_chain_with_x402.scenario: An autonomous agent purchases an API service via x402 payment. Lemma proves the agent had delegation authority and that the payment receipt is genuine.
businessImpact: Multi-agent transaction verified in under a second; no manual equivalent exists
Delegation chain provable post-hoc, no agent-log scraping needed
x402 payment cryptographically linked to authorized action

agent_replay_duplicate.label: Agent chain (duplicate)
agent_replay_duplicate.scenario: The same proof is submitted twice across two settlement steps — for example, a stuck retry loop in an agent pipeline. Lemma detects the duplicate proof_id and rejects the second submission.
agent_replay_duplicate.failReason: The same proof_id was already seen in a prior settlement step. The duplicate submission is rejected before any second debit can occur.

without: Duplicate settlement passes through both ledger entries
Funds debited twice from the agent's spending allowance
Manual reconciliation across two settlement systems required
with: Duplicate proof_id detected before the second settlement commits
Second submission rejected at the verification boundary
No reconciliation needed; ledger entries stay consistent
